title: New tools, more momentum: What’s new from Hinge Health
summary: Check out the latest updates to the Hinge Health app.
body_markdown:
Our app is never complete. We’re constantly exploring new ways to improve the member experience, whether it’s helping members choose an exercise, manage their pain, or decide what care they need next. Check out the latest updates:


**Redesigning the exercise experience**


Exercise therapy (ET) is central to how we treat members, and the demonstration videos serve as crucial guidance. The[new member experience](https://www.hingehealth.com/resources/articles/where-quality-care-meets-intentional-design-reimagining-the-hinge-health-app/) now offers a completely redesigned and expanded suite of ET videos in the Hinge Health app.


Along with a new visual identity that reflects an at-home environment, we’ve refreshed all of our existing exercises and we will be adding 220+ new exercises over time. This was made possible by 480+ hours of expert guidance from Hinge Health physical therapists across 60 production days, bringing this library to life while ensuring proper form. New categories of exercises will include:


-


Foam-rolling and Tissue Mobilization – a full suite of foam rolling exercises for the major muscle groups and comprehensive guidance to aid with full body recovery


-


Cervical and Neck – exercises to help bolster our migraine and neck-related programs


-


Post-surgical – more exercises supporting surgery recovery across a range of body areas


-


Nerve tensioners and Glides – exercises to help manage nerve-related symptoms


-


Balance and Plyometrics – exercises for members with higher-level functional goals or return to sport


-


And more!


Members can also access new controls in the exercise experience and during Movement Analysis sessions, so that they can more easily make their sessions work for them.


****


**Measuring balance, strength and difficulty through Movement Analysis**


Our Movement Analysis feature uses TrueMotion® computer vision technology to guide members through targeted movements. We launched it last year to provide PTs with insights to guide care plans and adjust exercise sessions, and gives members a "HingeScore" to monitor their mobility and progress over time.


We’ve applied that technology to multiple joint areas, and we’re proud to introduce new functional performance categories: balance, strength, and difficulty for relevant movements. This expanded range supports real-time motion assessment across multiple dimensions.


It is available now to all members who have indicated their back, hips, or knees as primary areas of focus across nearly every mobile device, with more joint areas on the way.


**Tracking momentum in the Progress tab**


The ability to measure and track progress over time is an important component of helping members stick to their care plans when life gets busy. The Progress tab turns daily effort into long-term visible momentum, further supporting healthy habits and adherence to care plans.


Completely redesigned to lead with a member’s recent activity, the Progress tab makes it easier for members to track their momentum with streaks, trendlines for pain across multiple body areas, and longitudinal HingeScore mapping over time. By measuring how a member’s condition evolves over time, we also provide tailored insights for what their next best action should be based on their pain levels.


**Making progress stick with Favorites**


Members asked, and we listened! The ability to save an exercise session or routine as a “favorite” emerged as one of our most requested features. Now, members can easily save any ET session with a single tap, then revisit saved sessions from the Explore tab. Quickly jumping into exercises they know work for them helps to build lasting habits around movement they love.


This highly anticipated feature is already rolling out to members. To date, more than 80,000 members have saved nearly 325,000 favorite sessions and counting.


**Turning goals into lasting habits with High Impact Coaching**


Each new member joins Hinge Health with a unique goal in mind, from getting back on their feet after an injury to staying healthy into their later years. High Impact Coaching is a 12-week, goal-driven coaching journey that provides members with targeted behavior change support.


The experience offers a dedicated lifestyle change plan that centers on a personal goal, giving members a clear next step and their full care team the context to make each conversation more relevant than the last. The result is behavioral coaching that is more focused, purposeful, and connected to the rest of the member’s care experience. Any member can start High Impact Coaching on their own, by choosing coaching in the app or through a referral from their PT. Coaches may also proactively reach out to members who seem like they need additional support.


Together, these updates reflect our continued commitment to making care more personalized, seamless, and accessible. From helping members build lasting habits to providing on-demand support and expanding into new areas of care, we’re giving members the tools and guidance they need to move forward with confidence.
